title: The Phone Box
source_body:
The Kim family always looked at their phones at dinner. Dad watched the news, Mom read emails, and Yerin played games. Nobody talked.
One Friday, Yerin's grandpa came to visit. He looked at the table and shook his head. Then he put an empty shoebox on the table. "This is the Phone Box," he said. "From now on, phones go in here during dinner."
At first, everyone was unhappy. But soon, Dad told a funny story about his first job. Mom talked about her school days. Yerin laughed so hard.
After dinner, they played a card game for one hour. Yerin won two games.
Now the Kim family uses the Phone Box every night. Dinner is Yerin's favorite time of the day.

variants.advanced:
Every evening, the Kim family sat around the dinner table, but they always looked at their phones instead of at each other. Dad watched the news, Mom checked her emails, and Yerin played games on her phone. Nobody said a single word.
One Friday, Yerin's grandpa came to visit. When he saw the quiet table, he shook his head sadly. Then he placed an empty shoebox in the middle of the table. "This is the Phone Box," he said. "From now on, everyone puts their phone in here during dinner."
At first, everyone looked unhappy and a little bored. But soon, Dad began to tell a funny story about his very first job. Mom shared stories about her school days, and Yerin laughed so hard that her stomach hurt.
After dinner, the family played a card game together for an hour. Yerin won two games and was very proud of herself.
Now the Kim family uses the Phone Box every night. Dinner has become Yerin's favorite time of the day.
variants.prestudy:
For a long time, dinner at the Kim family's house was strangely silent. Although everyone sat at the same table, each person's eyes were glued to a screen. Dad scrolled through the news, Mom answered work emails, and Yerin was busy playing games. Not a single word was spoken during the whole meal.
One Friday evening, Yerin's grandpa came over for a visit. Noticing the silent table, he shook his head in disappointment. Without saying anything, he placed an empty shoebox in the center of the table. "This is the Phone Box," he announced. "From now on, every phone goes in here while we are eating dinner."
At first, nobody looked pleased with the new rule. Before long, however, Dad started telling a hilarious story about the first job he had ever had. Mom joined in with memories of her school days, and Yerin laughed so hard that tears came to her eyes.
After dinner, the family spent an entire hour playing a card game together, and Yerin proudly won two rounds.
These days, the Phone Box is used at the Kim family's table every single night. Thanks to Grandpa's simple idea, dinner has become the time of day that Yerin looks forward to the most.
